### Functional summary

This 91-amino-acid sequence is an **exact sequence match** to reviewed UniProt entry **Q47WN6**, the bacterial **SdhE FAD assembly factor** from *Colwellia psychrerythraea*. The sequence also contains a Pfam **Sdh5 domain** (PF03937; residues 16–88).

SdhE is annotated as a **cytoplasmic assembly factor** that promotes covalent attachment of FAD to proteins, especially flavinylation of the SdhA subunit during **succinate dehydrogenase (respiratory complex II) assembly**. It supports complex II function in succinate metabolism and respiratory electron transfer; it is an assembly factor, not the succinate-oxidizing enzyme itself.

**Sequence-derived characteristics:** predicted mass **10.67 kDa**, theoretical pI **4.91**, and instability index **27.1**. These are computational estimates and do not account for processing or modifications. The function and identification are strongly supported by the exact match to a reviewed reference, though organism-specific experimental validation was not assessed here.
